channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Hidayet Turkoglu | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Hidayet Turkoglu from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Ersan Ilyasova on Hidayet Turkoglu
item.description:
But it didn’t take long – a conversation with Van Gundy, another with fellow Turk Hedo Turkoglu, text messages with his new teammates – before the possibilities with the Pistons invigorated him.

“I mentioned to Coach, (Turkoglu) called me and we talked about how he said the way we played in Orlando (under Van Gundy), the way you play and the way he liked to play with Coach and he shared a little bit,”

Ersan Ilyasova on Hidayet Turkoglu, Jun 16, 2015. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Hidayet Turkoglu
item.description:
Ben Bolch:Doc Rivers on Hedo Turkoglu coming into season in great shape:

“I didn’t know you could still develop muscles at 50 and I guess you can.”

Doc Rivers on Hidayet Turkoglu, Nov 5, 2014. Source: Twitter @latbbolch.

item.title: Lamar Odom on Hidayet Turkoglu
item.description:

Lamar Odom on Hidayet Turkoglu, Nov 15, 2010. Source: ESPN.com.
